args.title: AC-1: Continuing with all fields filled in goes to the order overview
args.steps:
1. Sign in as standard_user with password secret_sauce|Products page is displayed
2. Click the first Add to cart button|Cart badge shows "1"
3. Click the cart icon|Your Cart page is displayed
4. Click "Checkout"|Checkout: Your Information page is displayed
5. Enter "Jane" in the First Name field, "Doe" in the Last Name field, "12345" in the Zip/Postal Code field|Fields are populated
6. Click "Continue"|Page displays "Checkout: Overview" — the order overview is shown

args.title: AC-2: Continuing with a required field empty shows the appropriate error message
args.steps:
1. Sign in as standard_user with password secret_sauce|Products page is displayed
2. Click the first Add to cart button and then click the cart icon|Your Cart page is displayed
3. Click "Checkout"|Checkout: Your Information page is displayed
4a. Leave First Name empty, fill Last Name and Postal Code, click "Continue"|Page displays "First Name is required"
4b. Fill First Name, leave Last Name empty, fill Postal Code, click "Continue"|Page displays "Last Name is required"
4c. Fill First Name and Last Name, leave Postal Code empty, click "Continue"|Page displays "Postal Code is required"

args.title: AC-3: Cancel returns to the cart with the cart unchanged
args.steps:
1. Sign in as standard_user with password secret_sauce|Products page is displayed
2. Click the first Add to cart button|Cart badge shows "1"
3. Click the cart icon|Your Cart page is displayed with cart badge showing "1"
4. Click "Checkout"|Checkout: Your Information page is displayed
5. Click "Cancel"|Your Cart page is displayed and cart badge still shows "1" — cart is unchanged

args.title: AC-story: Checkout information page passes axe accessibility checks (WCAG 2.0 A/AA)
args.steps:
1. Sign in as standard_user with password secret_sauce|Products page is displayed
2. Click the first Add to cart button and then click the cart icon|Your Cart page is displayed
3. Click "Checkout"|Checkout: Your Information page is displayed
4. Run axe-core scan scoped to the checkout form with tags wcag2a and wcag2aa|No accessibility violations reported (violations array is empty)
